_meta.methodology: Reviewed publicly accessible official facility, membership, pricing, location, FAQ, and booking pages for San Francisco fitness facilities. Recorded a numeric monthlyPrice only when the source stated a recurring monthly price or a clearly labeled monthly equivalent. Recorded dayPassPrice for a day pass, single-class drop-in, or first-class trial only when the price and its meaning were explicit. Branches are separate records when a source exposed a distinct San Francisco address. Prices are not inferred from class packs, annual totals, or third-party listings.
limitations: This is a web-research supplement, not a complete census. Some booking systems hide prices behind JavaScript, ZIP-code selection, login, or a sales inquiry.
Promotions, enrollment fees, annual fees, taxes, eligibility restrictions, and facility-specific plans can change. The priceNote field explains the qualification for each numeric value.
No latitude/longitude is included unless it was confidently available from the reviewed source; addresses and names are provided for matching against the existing OSM import.
Some records are specialized studios, martial-arts schools, climbing gyms, or university/community facilities rather than conventional open gyms.
YMCA records use the organization-wide adult membership and free-day-pass pages; branch-specific amenities and hours should be verified before publication.
